company_name: Scientific Cyber Security Association of Ukraine (SCSA)
description: The Scientific Cyber Security Association of Ukraine (SCSA) is a nonprofit organization founded in 2024 dedicated to improving Ukraine's overall cybersecurity posture through scientific research, technical innovation, and educational programs. SCSA operates the CyberTeens online platform for schoolchildren's cyber hygiene, publishes the International Journal of Computer Network and Information Security (IJCNIS), runs the International Summer School for cybersecurity specialists, and manages the Veterano Cyber Cluster for veteran reintegration into cybersecurity careers. The association collaborates with international partners, government institutions, and educational organizations to develop cybersecurity labs, training courses, and research hubs in Ukraine and Georgia.

business_model: Nonprofit grant-funded model with revenue from training courses, membership fees, government contracts, and international project grants. Focus on educational programs, research publications, and veteran reintegration services.
pricing_model: Grant-funded and subsidized training; membership-based access; project-based government contracts; some free educational resources for schools
